chunks.name: Soy chunks, dry
chunks.source: Vantastic Foods label (macros); USDA soy flour (micros)

oat_bowl.title: Breakfast Oat Bowl
oat_bowl.desc: Overnight oats with soy drink, soy isolate, berries and seeds.
prep: Mix the night before in a jar.
steps: Stir oats, isolate and seeds into the soy drink.
Top with frozen berries, lid on, fridge overnight.

salad.title: Beet & Rucola Salad
steps: Whisk lemon, balsamic, Dijon, maple, garlic and salt.
Toss with rucola, sliced beet and onion.

pump.title: Pre-Workout Pump Drink
pump.desc: Citrulline, beta-alanine, taurine, salt and glycerol in 1.3 L water.
steps: Shake the dry mix with the glycerol into the water; drink over 10–15 min.

intra.title: Intra-Workout Juice
intra.desc: Apple juice 1:1 with water and a pinch of salt.
steps: Mix and sip from first working set to last.

pwo.title: Post-Workout Shake
pwo.desc: Soy drink, soy isolate and creatine.

rice.title: Weekly Rice Batch
rice.desc: 400 g dry basmati split into 23 equal parts: 4 per training bag, 3 for Sunday.
steps: Weigh, divide by 23, bag 5 × 4 parts + 1 × 3 parts, freeze.

curry.title: Chickpea Sweet Potato Curry
prep: Soak chunks in hot stock 10 min.
steps: Add paste, then everything else; simmer.

bolo.title: Soy Bolognese
bolo.desc: Rich batch, served on whole-wheat spaghetti.
